stories.title: Clinical Trials Input/Output Schema Validation
stories.description: Define and enforce Pydantic schemas for clinical trial search inputs (condition, location, radius) and outputs (trial metadata, locations, distance, duration) to ensure contract consistency across layers.

stories.title: Evaluate Care Facade Integration for Clinical Trial Search
stories.description: Integrate clinical trials service into evaluate_care_facade to orchestrate end-to-end flow from validated input through search, enrichment (distance), and formatted response.

stories.title: Tool Router Exposure for Clinical Trials Search
stories.description: Expose clinical trials search as an allowlisted tool via tool_router, including input validation, routing, and response formatting for LLM tool-use loop.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Clinical Trials Search Flow
stories.description: Implement unit tests for query builder, location normalization, and distance computation, plus integration tests covering full flow through facade and tool router with mocked external APIs.
